# Profile logo sources

- The Python, pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, FastAPI, Flask, Git, GitHub, VS Code, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and LinkedIn marks come from [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon). See the [bundled MIT license](LICENSE-Devicon.txt).
- The DuckDB mark comes from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/icons/duckdb.svg), distributed under [CC0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).
- The Power BI and Power Query icons come from Microsoft's [Power BI Icons collection](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerBI-Icons) under [CC BY 4.0](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerBI-Icons/blob/main/LICENSE).
- The Excel mark is Microsoft's [2019–2025 Excel logo](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Microsoft_Office_Excel_(2019%E2%80%932025).svg), via Wikimedia Commons.
- The Seaborn mark comes from the [Seaborn documentation source](https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn/blob/master/doc/_static/logo-mark-darkbg.svg). See the [bundled Seaborn license](LICENSE-Seaborn.txt).
- SQL uses a database glyph and Email uses an envelope. Both come from GitHub's [Octicons](https://github.com/primer/octicons/tree/main/icons) under the [bundled MIT license](LICENSE-Octicons.txt).
- The Portfolio icon is the [favicon from samhoon.xyz](https://samhoon.xyz/favicon.svg).

The marks are scaled to consistent dimensions and paired with text labels. Some monochrome fills were adjusted for contrast. Product names and logos identify the tools and contact destinations. LinkedIn is a registered trademark or trademark of LinkedIn Corporation and its affiliates in the United States and other countries.
